Descript vs VEXI: Editor or Social Media in One App?
Descript edits video by editing the transcript. VEXI edits the video for you, designs the post, and schedules and posts it.
Descript is one of the best editors for talking video. Here is how it compares with one app that also posts and plans your week.

Descript edits video and podcasts by editing the text of the transcript. It removes filler words, adds captions, can generate B-roll and music, turns long recordings into clips, and drafts social posts. Plans are priced per person: Hobbyist at $16 a month billed yearly ($24 monthly), Creator at $24 ($35 monthly) and Business at $50 ($65 monthly), with a no-cost tier of 60 media minutes.

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

The difference is what happens after the export. Descript publishes to YouTube from its web app and does not schedule. Your other accounts, and the rhythm of posting every week, are still on you. VEXI makes the post and puts it out. VEXI costs more than Descript: plans are $199, $399 or $599 a month. What you pay for is the work you no longer do.
Descript makes editing easier, but you are still the editor: reading the transcript, cutting, choosing and exporting.
VEXI edits the video for you: cuts, B-roll, music and captions. How deep the edit goes depends on your plan's mode, and anything you ask for wins.
Descript's help center describes publishing to YouTube from the web app, and not YouTube Shorts. Instagram, TikTok and the rest are a download and an upload.
VEXI schedules and posts to your connected accounts itself.
Users have asked for a scheduler on Descript's own feedback board, because it does not let you schedule videos.
VEXI Autopilot runs your week ahead: it writes, cuts and posts, and can wait for your approval on everything.
Descript's Trustpilot profile is rated 2.6. Some reviewers report crashes and lost edits, and AI tools that spend credits on results they did not ask for.
